description: This Java class implements the InterestRateChartWritePlatformService interface, providing methods to create, update, and delete interest rate charts within the Apache Fineract platform. It uses a repository pattern with transaction management for persistence and data validation before operations.

classes.name: InterestRateChartWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service interface for managing interest rate charts, with create, update, and delete functionalities, using dependency injection and transactional annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Validates incoming JSON command, assembles an InterestRateChart object, saves it, and returns the result with the new entity's ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Validates the update, applies changes to the existing InterestRateChart entity, saves it, and returns the update result including change details.

methods.name: deleteChart
methods.description: Finds and deletes an interest rate chart by ID, returning the result.
